title: Polynomial resolutions remain resolutions under Tor-independent tensoring
statement: Let $A\to B$ and $A\to A'$ be homomorphisms of commutative rings, put $B'=B\otimes_A A'$, and let $P_\bullet\to B$ be a polynomial resolution in the precise sense of [lem-trf-cotangent-resolution-coherence]. Thus $P_n$ is a polynomial $A$-algebra surjecting onto $B$, and the alternating-face complex $s(P_\bullet)\to B[0]$ is a quasi-isomorphism. If the canonical map $B\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}A'\to B'[0]$ is a quasi-isomorphism [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], then $P_\bullet\otimes_A A'\to B'$ is a polynomial resolution over $A'$, with its given tensor augmentation.
